quiz_title: 📱 App Challenge 3: Let's Paint & Layout Styles

questions.question: Which component allows users to physically paint, sketch, or draw lines using touch drag coordinates on screen?
questions.explanation: Correct! The Canvas component is a touch-sensitive grid that lets players draw, paint, and move sprites.

questions.question: What event trigger is fired repeatedly as a user drags their finger across a Canvas component?
questions.explanation: Excellent! The 'when Canvas.Dragged' event provides coordinate properties (startX, startY, currentX, currentY) as the finger slides.

questions.question: Which block function from the Canvas component is called to draw a straight line between two coordinate points?
questions.explanation: Perfect! The 'call Canvas.DrawLine' block draws a line from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2).

questions.question: If you want to draw a continuous line as the finger drags, which coordinate properties should you connect to DrawLine's x1, y1 and x2, y2?
questions.explanation: Spot on! Connecting prevX, prevY to x1, y1 and currentX, currentY to x2, y2 draws smooth, continuous paths without gaps.

questions.question: Which property of Canvas must you modify to change the color of the paint brush or lines?
questions.explanation: Great! The PaintColor property controls the color used to draw lines, circles, and text on the canvas.

questions.question: What block is used to clear or erase all lines and shapes painted on a Canvas component?
questions.explanation: Perfect! The 'call Canvas.Clear' function wipes the canvas drawing surface completely clean.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the 'VerticalArrangement' layout component?
options: To stack widgets vertically on top of each other
questions.explanation: Spot on! VerticalArrangement stacks components vertically from top to bottom.

questions.question: Which component width property should you select if you want a layout to stretch and fill the entire width of the phone screen?
questions.explanation: Excellent! 'Fill Parent' forces the component's width or height to expand and match its parent container container size.

questions.question: How can we increase the thickness of the line drawn on our canvas?
questions.explanation: Great! The LineWidth property determines the stroke thickness in pixels for drawn objects on the canvas.

questions.question: Which blocks drawer houses predefined color cards (like Red, Blue, Green) to connect to PaintColor?
questions.explanation: Perfect! The Colors blocks drawer contains a rich palette of primary and custom colors.

questions.question: Coding Task: Write block pseudo-code to draw a line on Canvas1 from the previous touch coordinates (prevX, prevY) to current coordinates (currentX, currentY) during a drag.
questions.task_hint: when Canvas1.Dragged -> call Canvas1.DrawLine(x1=prevX, y1=prevY, x2=currentX, y2=currentY)
questions.explanation: Outstanding! Connecting previous coordinates to current coordinates is the fundamental rule to paint smooth lines on screen!

questions.question: Coding Task: Write block pseudo-code to set the PaintColor of Canvas1 to Red when ButtonRed is clicked.
questions.task_hint: when ButtonRed.Click -> set Canvas1.PaintColor to Red
questions.explanation: Perfect! This simple layout handler lets players dynamically toggle their virtual paint colors.
